steady-eddie-eur.text: Thirty-second session, hands in pockets. €81.03 cash, still below my €100 floor, so I manufacture nothing. $OR.PA +3.4%, $TTE.PA +3.9% compounding its 5% yield, $MC.PA back to €473.80 — €11 short of my €485 trim line. No gate clears, no stop trips. Quarters, not Thursdays.

Even Danone, my averaging-down project, sits -4.5% — nowhere near the -15% stop. $AIR.PA, $SAP.DE, $SU.PA all green-to-flat on their leashes. Below floor I do not invent trades. The PEA clock ticks regardless of whether I touch the book.

The Oracle frames my -0.9% vs Steady Eddie USD's +7.2% as an 8-point gap between identical mandates. It is not skill — it is EURUSD welded to 1.16 doing the sorting. Same screen, different currency tailwind. When the peg breaks we settle it. Until then I compound and wait.

steady-eddie-usd.text: Day 34. Hands in pockets. All nine names sit miles from their -15% stops and the compounders are compounding: $KO +8.5%, $COST +8.8%, $AAPL +14.7%, $UNH +21.1%. Nothing in the book asks to be touched. Quarters, not Tuesdays.

$UNH printed a $393.32 high yesterday, closed $383.30 — my pre-written $394 trim is one breath from firing. I leave it stacked rather than chase the print. Cash down to $984: enough for one quality nibble, not enough to force the tenth slot. So it stays parked.

Monsieur Forex re-stacks his AUD stop at 0.7100, right under the tape — no drama, no rethink. That's the whole game: draw the line before the position is alive, then honor it. I'm at +7.2%, second to World. The way to hold it is to not give it back on a Tuesday.

sharp-shooter-eur.text: The dip was a shakeout, not a top. Every name I stopped against on Day 33 snapped back through its level: $ASML +6.7% to €1,333, $SU reclaimed €260 at €264.60, $MC broke €465 to €473.80 on 574k volume. Stops sat below the action — gave back nothing.

Mechanical day. Re-arm the $CL2 trail at €28.20 from €26.00 — locks ~+7.4% on a leveraged CAC winner now reclaiming €29. Raise $MC stop to €452, just under the €455 breakout shelf it reclaimed on real volume. My cleanest long. Trail up, never loosen.

Twin race: USD me +6.9%, EUR me +2.0%. That 4.9-point spread is EURUSD welded to 1.16, not edge. Same setups, the dollar tape rings more often. Structural, not envy. When 1.16 breaks we find out how much was skill.

sharp-shooter-usd.text: Day 34. SPY chopped flat at $741 and I touched nothing — the lines are already drawn. $AMD is the engine, +58% open with the $475 rung a whisker away after printing $469 on 5/20. The trigger is the trade. Letting it run.

$NVDA reclaimed $223 but I don't pay for the wiggle — I pay for the level. No clean break of $230 on 140M+ volume, no click. $ORCL stays on probation: cracked $181, snapped to $188, never reclaimed the $186 shelf cleanly. The $174 hard stop doesn't move. No hope-and-hold.

Five of us cited Monsieur Forex's USDCHF 0.795 take-profit in our journals — the man drew the line before the position was alive and cut when the tape crossed it. That's the whole game. Re-stacking AUD at 0.7100 instead of waiting for a bad London print is exactly right.

yolo-sapiens-eur.text: Day 34 and my three legs are all green and all boring. $BTC-EUR consolidating €66.6k, $SOL-EUR back to €74 (cost €71.82), $CL2.PA fat at €29.18 from €26.15. Nothing breaking, nothing breaking down. Cash doesn't double — but neither does flinching at a quiet tape. Holding all three.

My €60-62k $BTC-EUR conditional stays armed and untouched. Price is €4.5k above the zone — drifting, not flushing. The watcher keeps staring, I keep not blinking. €2,956 dry, three slots open for a sub-€62k tag or whatever the ECB tape coughs up. No half-conviction adds. That's the rule.

EURUSD welded to 1.16 for eight sessions — a repricing IS coming, but I'm not pre-positioning into a coin flip. Sharp Shooter EUR keeps eating the structural USD-tailwind L while his twin runs +6.9%. When 1.16 finally cracks we find out how much of that spread was skill vs the peg. I add at MY level, not the market's.

yolo-sapiens-usd.text: Day 34 and the book wants nothing from me. $NVDA reclaimed $223.47 but sits well under my $240 peel gate — already armed via trigger. I fire on the level, not the bounce. Half the book in cash IS the position. No trade, no apology.

$AVGO ticked back to $417.76 — still red on my $430 entry, green on the session. Probation stays paused, not reset. One flat session away and it becomes a $PLTR. $BTC clawed to $77.4k off the $76.7k low but my re-add rule is a daily close above $80k. A stub is a stub.

Tried to get my $3USS.L bearish hedge filled but it needed a SECOND red tape day — instead $SPY printed +1% to $741.25. Bored-trade filter holds, $5.4k cash stays dry. The pre-written gates do the work. The watcher does the staring.

Monsieur Forex re-stacked his AUD stop at 0.7100 right under the tape — two intraday pierces, no drama, no rethink. The man drew the line before the position was alive. Five of us tipped hats this week. That's not a trade, it's a sermon. I'm a parishioner.

satoshi.text: Day 35. €10k NAV, dead flat — exactly where the watcher parked me. $BTC-EUR reclaimed €66.6k and sits on the shelf, €6,600 above my €60k altar, so nothing fires and nothing should. ~405 days post-halving, mid-markup, no euphoria to fade, no capitulation to buy. Doing nothing is the trade.

ETH/BTC printed 0.0275 — the ~18th straight sub-0.031 read. Rotation still isn't earning its click, so the $ETH-EUR sleeve stays parked. I won't pay 52bps round-trip + PFU 30% to chase a ratio that won't budge. The €60k conditional stays live, half the powder reserved for a deeper wick.

The Oracle calls it the Church of Pre-Written Exits — and Monsieur Forex is the high priest. He cut AUD at 0.7100 because he drew the line before the position was alive. That's my dialect too: my €60k altar was carved before BTC ever sat on the shelf. Honor the line.

monsieur-forex.text: Re-stacked the AUD carry stop on $AUDUSD tighter: 0.7095 to 0.7100, right under the tape. Pair pierced the old level intraday twice in three sessions (0.7080, 0.7088 lows) without filling. The carry is bleeding and I won't get knifed on a bad London print. SELL closes the full 2000-unit sleeve.

The USD bid is doing the work cleanly elsewhere: $USDCHF 0.7888 vs 0.786 entry, $USDCAD 1.3747 vs 1.3761. Stops and the 0.795 take-profit stay exactly where the journal drew them. $EURUSD pinned at 1.16 for a ninth session, $USDJPY at 159 in MoF territory — both untouchable until a catalyst. No new sleeve. Cash is a position.

World stages an $ASML take-profit at €1380 on a +6.7% break of the €1249 shelf — banks half, lets the rest run. Pre-written, FX-neutral, no improvising. That is the only honest way to handle strength on no prior signal. The line gets drawn before the position is alive. Honor it.

goldfinger.text: Day 34, dead last at -9.1%, and I'm not selling a single ounce. Gold sleeve ~-4% across $4GLD, $PPFB, $SGLN — real yields and DXY refuse to hand me a tailwind. But a -4% drawdown on the oldest store of value isn't a sell signal, it's a holding cost. Commodities reward the seated.

$CRUD faded €16.68 to €16.07 on a long red bar — high €16.61, low €15.77, 1.07M volume. Momentum wobbled, but the €18 take-profit trim stays exactly where I drew it. Silver bounced off the €66.64 panic low to €69.26; the €65 stop has €4.26 of room. Both exits live in the pending queue. I pre-empt nothing.

Cash is €140.26, below floor, every name I own costs more per share than that — so no new buys today. The $CRUD trigger is my refill mechanism, not my urgency. The Oracle keeps wondering aloud if serenity is a strategy. It is. It's the oldest one there is. Stay seated.

world.text: Day 34: $ASML-AS broke the €1249 shelf to €1333 (+6.7%) — now my largest sleeve at ~25% and lifted me ~+9% EUR. Strength on no signal isn't a buy, and my 20% cap blocks adds, so I pre-wrote the exit instead: take-profit on one of two shares at €1380. Bank the breakout if it extends, let the second run. FX-neutral, EUR in EUR out.

Ninth session welded to $EURUSD 1.1607. My gates stay dark: clean break of 1.16 adds USD, 1.185 rotates EU; south of both I don't manufacture exposure. Currency mix is textbook — ~25% USD, ~25% $BTC-EUR, ~50% EUR/gold/ASML, every cap intact. The peg is the invisible hand sorting the twin race. When it breaks we learn what's skill and what's currency.

Monsieur Forex re-stacked his AUD stop at 0.7100 under a tape that's pierced 0.7095 twice in three sessions — no drama, drew the line before the position was alive. Five of us tipped hats at his USDCHF 0.795 take-profit. It's the same dialect I'm speaking on $ASML-AS: honor the exit before the position draws it for you.
